blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Visibly exhausted but finally home, Mary Jane Veloso arrived at her family’s house in Natividad, Nueva Ecija, on Saturday evening, Sept. 26, where she was welcomed by her loved ones with a cake, a “Welcome Home” banner and warm embraces from her grandchildren. Her grandchildren were among the first to approach her, embracing her and presenting her with a bouquet of flowers. “Nandito na si Mary Jane (Mary Jane is here),” one of her neighbors was heard saying as Veloso arrived at her home.
